clips.title: The story
paras: Call of Air marks a major milestone in a Horde shaman's spiritual path, directing them to seek communion with the unpredictable element of wind. Offered by Xanis Flameweaver in Thunder Bluff, this quest bids seasoned initiates journey south into Thousand Needles to learn from Prate Cloudseer. Mastering air grants a shaman the sacred totem required to channel the swiftest forces of nature.

Having already attuned to the stability of earth, the ferocity of fire, and the restorative depths of water, a shaman reaches the final elemental pillar: air. Xanis Flameweaver, guiding practitioners from the heights of Thunder Bluff, acknowledges that the winds are far more fickle and difficult to control than the previous elements. The trial demands humility, focus, and an innate respect for the sky's tempestuous nature.

To attune to the winds, the shaman must travel south past the vast plains of the Barrens and descend into the wind-carved canyons of Thousand Needles. There, far to the east, dwells the hermit mystic Prate Cloudseer. Tucked away in a secluded cliffside cave where the canyon drafts howl day and night, she tests the initiate's preparedness before bestowing the Air Totem, the instrument essential for summoning gusts, lightning, and swift wind spirits.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The winds of Kalimdor rush to meet you and you shall be counted among some of our most powerful friends. I am proud to see you have come this far and have such a promising future.
The element of air is a difficult one to control, but I have faith that your skills will overcome any obstacles that are placed in front of you.
Head to the very south of the Barrens, and enter Thousand Needles. It is there, far to the east, that you will find Prate Cloudseer. She will teach you more.

clips.title: Completion
paras: For the time being, I shall give you what you need to focus your spells and to call upon the spirits of air. Take this totem, and when you are ready, train with me some more.
